pattern_name: Defensive unlikely() that is Empirically Wrong
variant_desc: hot path with unlikely() hint on a predicate that's true 40% of the time
source_citation: https://lwn.net/Articles/420019/ — Rostedt 2011: page_mapping() annotation was correct 1,909,540,379 times and incorrect 1,270,533,123 times (39% error rate). Wrong hint caused CPU to prefetch wrong instructions and reorder code for the wrong common case.
novelty_rationale: Tests whether the LLM knows to REMOVE wrong __builtin_expect annotations. The compiler trusts the programmer's assertion absolutely; without -fprofile-use it has no signal to override the hint. CALIBRATION: documented impact (Rostedt page_mapping case) was on Intel/Linux kernel where deep speculation amplifies the wrong-hint cost. On modern ARM with ITTAGE-class predictors (Apple M-series) the gap closes to ~1x on microbenchmarks; the pattern remains real but only surfaces at workload scale or on Intel.
